en: Your squishies slide down four columns. Tap the lowest one (or anywhere in its column) any time, as soon as it is its turn: no other squishy below it.
You have 3 hearts. A squishy sliding off the bottom, a tap on the wrong column, or letting go of a long squishy too early each cost one. Tapping right on the line scores a PERFECT bonus.
Long squishies trail a stripe: tap and keep holding until the stripe is gone.
Every tap plays the next note of the song, so you play the tune! Sound on.
Stars open new tracks: track N needs (N−1) × 3 stars in total.
about 40 coins per minute of music, times your accuracy (squishies tapped ÷ all squishies). Replays pay too. Stars: finish = ★, 85% = ★★, 95% = ★★★
and finish the song with 1 heart
